entries.title: Publicis Bought LiveRamp. What APAC Operators Do Monday Morning.
entries.excerpt: Publicis is paying 2.167 billion dollars for LiveRamp. From inside an APAC adtech acquisition, the read on what changes Monday morning for operators running real media budgets.

entries.title: Publicis Bought LiveRamp. The Gulf Sovereignty Question Now.
entries.excerpt: From an operator who has watched Gulf demand connect to APAC supply for seven years, the read is about sovereignty as much as adtech.

entries.title: Publicis Bought LiveRamp. EU Operators Will Make Three Calls.
entries.excerpt: French ownership repackages the legal exposure of a US identity stack under GDPR and the AI Act. Three calls EU operators will need to make.

entries.title: Brussels Postponed Its AI Act. The Hard Deadlines Are Still Real.
entries.excerpt: At 4:30 in the morning of 7 May 2026, EU co-legislators agreed the AI Omnibus, deferring Annex III obligations to December 2027. The hard deadlines have not moved.

entries.title: Law Before Models: Inside South Korea's Governance-First AI Bet.
entries.excerpt: South Korea is the first country in the world running a fully enforced national AI law. Its own startup association admits only 2 per cent of AI startups are export-ready.

entries.title: AI Fluency Is Now Asia's Graduate Hiring Default.
entries.excerpt: Singapore's 40,000 worker pivot, India's 150,000 developer programme and Japan's 2.3 million target have made AI fluency the baseline screen.

entries.title: The Slow Bet: How Japan Is Building AI That Refuses To Race.
entries.excerpt: Japan does not look like a country in an AI race. What it has is a slow accumulation of laws, line items and small models that taken together form a distinct doctrine.

entries.title: Europe Just Got a Frontier AI Lab Map. It Does Not Look Like Silicon Valley.
entries.excerpt: In seventeen days, three deals redrew Europe's frontier AI lab map. SAP, Schwarz Group, and ASML are now doing what US venture capital used to.

entries.title: The Quiet Sovereign: How Singapore Wrote Asia's AI Playbook With 5.9 Million People.
entries.excerpt: Singapore is not racing China on chips or training a frontier LLM. It is doing the slower thing: a rulebook, a compute plan and a workforce ladder others can adopt.

entries.title: Three Capitals, Three Bets: Inside the Arabic LLM Race in Abu Dhabi, Riyadh, and Doha.
entries.excerpt: Falcon-H1 leads the Open Arabic LLM Leaderboard. ALLaM 34B ships in Saudi. Fanar 2.0 holds Doha. Three Arabic AI bets, one language.

entries.title: Europe Wants to Triple Its Data Centre Capacity. The Power Grid Has Other Ideas.
entries.excerpt: The Cloud and AI Development Act is meant to unlock the tripling of EU data centre capacity. The binding constraint is no longer permits. It's electrons.

entries.title: Three Kinds of Sovereignty: Why HUMAIN's $1.2 Billion Bet Is Still Looking for Its Identity.
entries.excerpt: PIF's HUMAIN venture is Saudi Arabia's answer to the global AI race. Sovereign AI is not a single thing: data residency, model residency, or talent residency.
